# 🔍 Code Review Checklist

- [ ] Change matches approved scope.
- [ ] Application source and data boundaries were respected.
- [ ] No secrets or personal data were introduced.
- [ ] Error paths and validation were considered.
- [ ] Tests use temporary/synthetic data.
- [ ] Documentation matches actual behavior.
- [ ] Local links and assets resolve.
- [ ] Build/test evidence is attached.
- [ ] Known limitations and deferred items are disclosed.
